references.text: The same chapter shows a similar pattern where the father-in-law urges the man to strengthen himself with food before he leaves
The father-in-law persuades the man to stay overnight, the same motif that is repeated in verse 9
Lot's hospitality and invitation to stay overnight recall the father-in-law's hospitality in Judges
Laban's family asks Abraham's servant to stay longer, a similar theme of hospitality
Abraham shows hospitality and invites the guests to stay, a recurring theme throughout Scripture
The consequence of leaving late in the day leads to them having to spend the night in Gibeah
